name: Closing Bell
tagline: Four suits, four stocks: pump, crash, and cash out before the bell.
core_loop: On your turn play one card to a market pile to set that suit's price, or into your portfolio as a share, or sell a share to bank the top price card; then refill to four.
win_condition: Highest wealth (banked vault ranks + current price of every share + closing-bell die bonus) when the deck and all hands are empty.
